name: Missing Entanglement Handler
hint: An entanglement-start handler can run only when the actor participates in an entanglement. If no operation entangles the actor directly or through another participant, the script is unreachable and its behavior never occurs.
instruction: Keep the handler on an actor that a suitable entanglement block can reach, or add an entanglement operation that includes this actor.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when entanglement started :: events hat #5c068c
forever
turn right (15) degrees
wait (0.1) seconds
end
